protocol.purpose: Exploratory 2x2 screen of 64/96 base rows and existing cold dispatch, with 32 GiB residency.
rules: Run one trial at a time; restore Qwen each time.
Stop on any guard, execution, configuration or evidence failure.
Do not change source or guards during this screen.
Single samples are exploratory, not a stable effect estimate. Recheck the chosen profile and score autoregressive answers.
